description: Current Claude Code draws no 'esc to interrupt' while working and no '? for shortcuts' while idle, so the pre-2.x markers matched nothing and every screen-based recovery silently disabled — an answered approval stayed displayed for the rest of the turn. The spinner phrase ellipsis is the frame-recurring working marker, and a live dialog (its own affordances, 'Esc to cancel') still vetoes the resume.
